definitions.meaning: A fragment or short portion of time

quotations.old_english: Æ-acute;ghwæðæs ðe hie on ǽnegum hiora hwílsticcum geearnian mǽgen
quotations.english: all that they can earn in any of their fragments of time

source_text: hwíl-stycce, es; n. A fragment or short portion of time :-- Æ-acute;ghwæ ðæs ðe hie on ǽnegum hiora hwílsticcum geearnian mǽgen all that they can earn in any of their fragments of time, L. Alf. pol. 43; Th. i. 92, 12.
